newsitem.title: SWEDEN: MTG in deal with Universal International.
newsitem.headline: MTG in deal with Universal International.

text.p: The Modern Times Group (MTG), a unit of Swedish media and publishing group Kinnevik, said on Wednesday it had signed an agreement to buy films and TV series from Universal International Television.
Universal International Television is a unit of Universal Studios which in turn is a unit of Seagram Co Ltd .
"MTG and Universal International have reached the most extensive agreement ever in Scandinavia about buying films and TV series," Kinnevik said in a statement.
The agreement gives MTG broadcasting rights for a wide range of Universal's feature films and TV products for the coming three years.
MTG owns television stations TV3, TV6, ZTV and 3+ that can show more than 60 Universal feature films such as The American President, Apollo 13, Babe and The Nutty Professor.
MTG's managing director Pelle Tornberg said Universal and MTG had worked closely for the past five years.
"This new agreement will strengthen the relationship," he said in the statement.
"The agreement can also open doors for further cooperation in the future."
No financial details about the agreement were released.
